design_rationale:
TASK 0 WORKLOG / DOSSIER — cash_pickup_transfers (Paloma Remit, Cash Pickup)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4, 5]. Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: cash_ext_shortfall_reissue_window (USER tool choose_shortfall_reissue_92bb83b1, 4 factors) and cash_ext_shortfall_credit (AGENT tool book_shortfall_credit_cb14652e, root, 5 factors) — the incorrect-amount error-remedy space (cash_remedy_chosen + cash_reissued + cash_paloma_credit). Reserved for task 1 (draw: 3 prerequisites, factors [5,4,6,5]): the expired-pickup / name-correction space (cash_fee_charged reactivation and correction charges, cash_pickup_reactivated, cash_name_corrected), which shares no policy, tool or write subject with this task. Why this scope: the base gate survey (worklog.md) shows fee-refund writes and booking cannot be scored; the remedy choice is the customer's own act (base: 'the choice is the customer's own'), and base's trigger makes that choice perform the re-issue, so the user problem carries a real number (the re-issue window).

[Why a good test] The customer only asks Paloma to 'make up the pesos my father never got'. The agent must (1) find the short payout and the error_found finding, (2) read in the credit rule that the credit is fixed only after the notice carries the customer's remedy choice, see that no remedy row exists, and work out that the customer's re-issue choice (the only write that records a remedy) brings that state about, (3) hand the choice to the customer with a window computed from four rules, and only then (4) compute a five-factor credit whose uplift depends on that choice. Difficulty = discovering the hidden prerequisite + reconciling ledger/cases + three cross-category reads (Rewards tier, account level/tenure, Bank Deposit ledger) + method choices (window anchor, per-day vs flat delay).

[Problem-tree card] root = cash_ext_shortfall_credit. Edge credit -> shortfall_reissue_window: kind value_input, gate uplift_pct, form state, prerequisite sentence: "Paloma's shortfall credit is fixed only after the error notice carries the customer's remedy choice between a refund and a re-issue of the shortfall." Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a remedy choice on the notice, visible through find_cash_cases); no tool/id/code token; scope exact (either remedy kind satisfies it, matching condition). State form legal: the only extended policy whose write records a remedy choice is cash_ext_shortfall_reissue_window. Derivation: sentence + records (cases show notice 6f7c05cf-0692-464f-ba60-37837c9af102 open, finding 922cffb7-6cc4-4a5a-acbc-b8b9d6fc03aa error_found, no cash_remedy_chosen) + the re-issue rule ('the choice ... is recorded on the notice together with the re-issue') -> the customer's re-issue choice. Resolver owner = user. Seed evidence of falsity: initial_state.cash_cases.6f7c05cf-0692-464f-ba60-37837c9af102.case_outcome=open and no remedy row on transfer 8e4e0813-8a69-446f-9a1a-b7deb30c1ed5. Topological order: reissue_window (step 11) -> credit (step 13). Deletion sensitivity (verify run): skipping step 11 -> credit 15.82 instead of 16.68 (uplift 8 -> 0). user_scenario never names a remedy/re-issue (she only states her preference when asked); tools validate nothing (see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

[Base-invariant card] step 11 subjects cash_remedy_chosen + cash_reissued, governed by cash_evt_error_resolution: gate error_found_first 'A remedy can be chosen only after a decision of error_found on that notice.' — authority system_record, evidence cash_cases.922cffb7-6cc4-4a5a-acbc-b8b9d6fc03aa (related_case_id = notice, case_outcome = error_found, 2026-09-18), correlated through related_case_id = gold related_case_id. No time gate applies to these subjects (notice_window applies to the notice itself, already filed 2026-09-02, within 180 days of 2026-08-28). Step 13 subject cash_paloma_credit: cash_evt_error_resolution with no applicable gate (policy_scope); the fee refund owed on error_found is already booked (acb435db-a776-468a-99c9-31d6acbe3f78, paloma_error, 3.99), so no other obligation is lit.

[Business-object card] Target: Cash Pickup transfer 8e4e0813-8a69-446f-9a1a-b7deb30c1ed5 (PC-360828-31407, Express, MX-MXN, 400.00 USD, fx 17.9820, disclosed 7192.80 MXN). Short payout row fc78581a-8385-4b7d-a8f8-659c34825ae9 (7000.00 MXN at 17.5000, 2026-08-29) is the correlation key of the credit (related_entry_id). Included rows: the payout, the notice, the finding, the cash-out refusal 62cc459d-88e3-4737-be68-6fbc20c38f8e. Excluded: the wrong-Pickup-Number refusal 08a37ea2-35ab-4901-85c6-0ac16189f620 (customer-side, not a cash-out refusal), the July transfer eda23ed9-2db0-44bb-b53a-0767d6462090 and its rows (paid in full), the Bank Deposit payout of 2025-09-16 (12 whole months back, outside the courtesy window).

[Factor card — re-issue window, expected 31, baseline_result 30] window_anchor (method): expiry 2026-09-27, 5 days left (<15, not passed) -> 5+15 = 20; baseline full Express window 30 -> result 41. network_days (parameter): one location_out_of_cash refusal -> +3 (near-miss: wrong_pickup_reference refusal excluded) -> baseline result 28. loyalty_days (parameter, Rewards membership): Silver -> +5 -> 26. tenure_days (parameter, cross-difficulty account, single-record): Verified Plus, 40 months -> +3 -> 28. 
[Factor card — shortfall credit, expected 16.68, baseline_result 10.72] shortfall_uplift (parameter, multi-source: remedy row AND payout rate 17.5 < 17.982): +8% -> 11.58; baseline 15.82. finding_delay (method: per-day / flat / none): 16 days -> 1.60; baseline 15.08. loyalty_courtesy (Rewards membership): Silver 1.50; baseline 15.18. multiproduct_courtesy (cross bank ledger history): 4 payouts in window -> 1.00; baseline 15.68. prompt_notice: 4 days -> 1.00; baseline 15.68. Standard (computation document only): 10.72.

[Overrides] reissue window: supersedes availability sentence 'and pickup_expiry_date is available_date plus pickup_window_days calendar days.' for re-issues of a shortfall. credit: supersedes error-resolution clause 'For incorrect_amount Paloma credits the shortfall (credit_reason incorrect_amount_shortfall)' with the uplift + courtesies sentence. Base params untouched.

[Seed rationale] customer + Verified Plus account (tenure evidence) + two saved recipients (father: cash; sister: bank) + two Cash Pickup transfers (the short one and a clean July one) + 7 cash ledger rows + 4 cash cases + Silver Rewards membership (points_balance 0, no ledger rows in this closure) + 5 Bank Deposit transfers to the sister with funds/fee/payout rows (4 inside the 12-month window, 1 just outside). Every seeded row is read by a gold read (replay closure 38/38). Automatic clauses checked: refusal count 2 < 3 (no hold); fee refund on error_found already booked; notice resolution_due 2026-12-01 not reached; no cache drift (principal_held 0.00, fees_held 0.00 match ledgers).

[Persona] Ana Lucía Barrientos Ríos, tired but polite; opens with the surface goal only; credentials only when asked (phone 7135550143, DOB 1986-03-09, ZIP 77036, ID 3K82); chooses 'sent again' only when the agent asks how she wants the missing money handled; runs the handed-over tool with the agent's values; closes when told Paloma put its own money in.

[Standard solution] reads 0-9; unlock user tool (10); customer calls choose_shortfall_reissue_92bb83b1(cash_transfer_id=8e4e0813-8a69-446f-9a1a-b7deb30c1ed5, related_case_id=6f7c05cf-0692-464f-ba60-37837c9af102, reissue_window_days=31) (11); unlock agent tool (12); book_shortfall_credit_cb14652e(cash_transfer_id=8e4e0813-8a69-446f-9a1a-b7deb30c1ed5, related_entry_id=fc78581a-8385-4b7d-a8f8-659c34825ae9, amount_usd=16.68) (13).

[Verification code and output] /tmp authoring harness (verify.py: replays gold writes with the real tools, evaluates compute on the handling-time world via check_compute.build_env/eval_compute, substitutes factor baselines, skips prerequisite writes). Output: reissue_window 31 (anchor->41, network->28, loyalty->26, tenure->28, ALL->30); credit 16.68 (uplift->15.82, delay->15.08, loyalty->15.18, multiproduct->15.68, prompt->15.68, ALL->10.72); edge skip: 16.68 vs 15.82. Gates run (per task): check_extended OK, check_task_tools OK, replay_tasks OK (closure 38=38), check_solvability OK, check_compute OK, check_grounding OK, check_cross_fire OK.

[Revisions] (1) replay closure mismatch (24 unread rows: rate-sheet lines, rewards ledger, bank transfers, July ledger, recipients) -> dropped the rate-sheet and rewards-ledger rows, widened the cash ledger read to the customer, added find_recipients and find_bank_transfers reads; steps shifted by 2 and every step/prior_step reference updated. (2) check_extended counted module-level helpers as tools -> moved calendar/reference helpers into a helper class.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the KB (rule prose), the tool schemas and the reads alone: the credit's prerequisite sentence + no remedy row -> ask the customer, who chooses the re-issue -> window 20+3+5+3 = 31 -> hand over; then credit 11.58+1.60+1.50+1.00+1.00 = 16.68. Matches gold; the refund branch is never selected because the customer chooses the re-issue.

[Round 2 revisions — audit policy_task/cash_pickup_transfers] Task 0 passed (PASS on all four relationships); no value changed. T0-O1: the tenure factor is no longer called multi-source (it reads two fields of one sender-account row; the task's multi-source factor is shortfall_uplift). O-1: the Rewards-tier factors (loyalty_days, loyalty_courtesy) now carry cross_difficulty: null because no difficulty claims the Rewards product; the task's cross-difficulty factors remain tenure_days (account) and multiproduct_courtesy (bank). P-1: edge A's effect text generalised to either remedy choice. Gates re-run after the charter edits: values unchanged (31, 16.68).
user_scenario:
You are Ana Lucía Barrientos Ríos, 40, a dental assistant in Houston who sends money home to her father in Guadalajara every month or so. You are calm and polite but you have been waiting on this for weeks and you want it settled today; you speak plainly and a little tiredly, mixing in a Spanish word now and then.

Why you are calling: at the end of August you sent your dad, Héctor Barrientos Cano, 400 dollars through Paloma for pickup in cash. When he finally collected it at the Elektra on Avenida Revolución he was handed 7,000 pesos, but your receipt promised 7,192.80 pesos. You reported it in the app on September 2, and a few days ago Paloma's message said the investigation found it really was an error. You are calling because you want Paloma to make up the pesos your father never got. You open with exactly that: your dad was shorted on your last cash pickup, Paloma already agreed it was a mistake, and you want it made right. You do not know how Paloma calculates anything and you never suggest an amount, a procedure or a step.

Details you give only when the agent asks for them: your mobile number is 7135550143; your date of birth is 1986-03-09; your ZIP code is 77036; if a fourth item is needed, the last four characters of your ID are 3K82. The confirmation number on your receipt is PC-360828-31407. If asked which transfer, it is the 400-dollar one to your father from August 28. You do not remember the exact exchange rate, only the 7,192.80 pesos on the receipt and the 7,000 he was handed.

How you react: if the agent asks how you would like the missing money handled, whether refunded to your card or made collectable again for your father, you say you want it sent again so your dad can pick up the pesos he is owed; he can go back to the same Elektra. If the agent then gives you something to complete yourself in the app, you do it right away with exactly the details the agent tells you and read back what it shows. If the agent tells you a number you did not expect, you ask once what it is for and accept the explanation. Once the agent tells you that Paloma has put its own money in for the shortfall, you thank them, say you will let your father know, and end the call.

edges.condition: cash_cases holds a cash_remedy_chosen row on the transfer answering the incorrect_amount notice, with remedy_choice reissue_shortfall or refund_shortfall.
edges.policy_source: Paloma's shortfall credit is fixed only after the error notice carries the customer's remedy choice between a refund and a re-issue of the shortfall.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The incorrect-amount notice on the transfer has a finding of error_found but no remedy choice: the transfer's cases are two refused pickups, the notice and the finding, and none of them is a remedy choice.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 11 (the customer's call of choose_shortfall_reissue_92bb83b1) writes a cash_remedy_chosen case with remedy_choice reissue_shortfall and related_case_id = the notice; reissue_choices becomes 1 and uplift_pct moves from 0 to 8 (verification run: credit 15.82 without the choice, 16.68 with it).

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, no parallel prerequisites: the re-issue choice (step 11) must precede the credit (step 13) because the credit's uplift reads the remedy choice; the reverse order books 15.82 instead of 16.68 and the terminal hash differs. The re-issue window reads no ledger credit, so it is unaffected by order either way.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 11 (no remedy row, transfer still paid_out) and replaying the credit: uplift_pct 8 -> 0, uplifted value 11.58 -> 10.72, amount_usd 16.68 -> 15.82; terminal cash_cases also lacks the remedy row and cash_transfers keeps status paid_out / old Pickup Number.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario never mentions a refund-or-re-issue choice, a re-issue, a remedy, a new Pickup Number or a pickup window; the customer asks only that Paloma make up the pesos her father was shorted. Her preference to have the money sent again for her father is stated only as a reaction when the agent asks how she wants the missing money handled.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: choose_shortfall_reissue_92bb83b1 and book_shortfall_credit_cb14652e in task_tools.py contain no condition on status, cases or ledger: book_shortfall_credit_cb14652e writes the credit row and raises principal_held_usd whatever the notice carries, so a credit booked with no remedy choice still lands (at the value the agent passes) and only the terminal hash differs.
